damage.source: GOB 247 stores one instant Ballistic health modifier with fixed base 25.
damage.runtime: The normal hostile effect expands the cone once and applies Ballistic style and linked bonuses, then each recipient's typed resistance.
damage.test: DualSmgConesUseTheMatchingBallisticInfluenceAndResistance verifies +9/+3/+4 inputs and 28→26 against +20 resistance. The stock run landed 28 on each eligible opponent. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/913#issuecomment-7092924331

controls.source: GOB 247 stores a 15% landed Enrage for eight seconds.
controls.runtime: Each eligible landed recipient resolves the authored chance independently through the standard Enraged state.
controls.test: ConditionalControlTests tests both sides of the 15% roll and expiry. The live retest saw the non-proc branch, and PR357 previously witnessed a natural eight-second Enrage from 247 on the stock-selected dummy. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/357#issuecomment-7015751646 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/913#issuecomment-7092924331

area.source: GOB 247 specifies a selected-hostile 45-degree cone of 8 m.
area.runtime: Expansion uses the admitted aim and rechecks hostile membership and visible valid recipients. Exactly-on-boundary candidates are eligible.
area.test: DualSmgConeLandsItsFixedBallisticComponentOnlyOnEligibleRecipients tests yaw, radius and exclusion. Stock admitted QAOther just inside the half-angle and excluded the just-outside QAFar and allied QAFriend. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/913#issuecomment-7092924331

targeting.source: GOB 247 requires a selected enemy and the dual-SMG weapon category from rest.
targeting.runtime: Normal admission checks the selected live view/spawn, range and sight, and keeps the original aim through the cast; no active-interlock entry is created.
targeting.test: DualSmgConeRefusesBeforeCostOrPreservesTheAdmittedAim covers the selected, missing, stale, wrong weapon, line-of-sight and current-fight cases. Both native heads supply scoped refusals, and the retest saw the stock actions blocked in active interlock. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/913#issuecomment-7092924331

choreography.source: GOB 247 stores a 2 s outside-combat cast with no success-interlock move.
choreography.runtime: The ordinary timed cast presents a direct multi-recipient hit after release.
choreography.test: Stock Bullet Spray showed the 2 s cast and direct hit, and its hotbar refused in an active fight; neither action opened an interlock. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/913#issuecomment-7092924331

source-parity.source: The GOB supplies base 25, 30 IS, 2 s cast, 10/5 s own/group 690, 45 degrees and 8 m, plus its authored landed control.
source-parity.runtime: Player casts use the authored weapon, selected cone, fixed Ballistic base and control. The longer archived 248 root is preserved for its NPC caster context.
source-parity.test: Native verifies 30 IS, 2 s, 10/5 s, scope and 28 damage with all loaded bonuses. Both context timings and all typed calculations have focused tests. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/913#issuecomment-7092924331

behavior-tests.source: Shipped ability fields and modifiers define the cast gates, typed hit, cone membership and landed control.
behavior-tests.runtime: Standard selection and the shared hostile effect, resistance and timed-control executors consume those values.
behavior-tests.test: The player recipient, boundary, no-target/debit, resistance and timed-control regressions supplement the observed stock casts, visible effects and matched removal data. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/913#issuecomment-7092924331
